tasks.title: Language switch under the brand
tasks.request: A small switch under the Cube Coach title with a flag and the code for each language; the header should always stay on the left
tasks.summary: The switch is now one small segmented control under the brand, each language's flag over its code, shown on the welcome screen only; the header stays top-left in Hebrew. Chosen from five mocked variants and live since 2026-11-04.

items.note: Builds the switch once inside the header and marks the current language on every screen change, instead of drawing name buttons into the welcome screen.
The segmented look with a flag over each code, shown on the welcome screen only; the header no longer mirrors in Hebrew.
Each language now carries its flag and code next to its name and direction.
Checks the switch sits in the header, shows the codes, and hides on every other screen.

tasks.title: Hebrew and Polish
tasks.request: Translations to Hebrew and Polish with a switch on the home screen only; Max reviews the language
tasks.summary: Every word moved into one table with English proven unchanged by a screen snapshot; Hebrew reads right to left with the cube and grids pinned; both languages shipped on 2026-11-04 after Max tried the app. The reviewer's list of lines a native speaker may pause at is still open for Max.

items.note: The one place every sentence lives in all three languages, with plural and per-color forms so Polish cases and Hebrew gender read right.
Reads every word through the table, saves the chosen language apart from progress, and sets the page direction for Hebrew.
Every camera-sheet sentence and tip comes from the table.
Pins the 3D cube, grids, arrows, palette and notation left-to-right in Hebrew and gives Hebrew text a font that has its letters.
Fails on any sentence missing in a language, a mismatched placeholder, or a malformed plural or color set.
Walks 22 screens per language: English must match its snapshot, Hebrew must hold no Latin word, Polish no English word, and every screen must fit the phone.

tasks.title: Review fixes
tasks.request: Verify all the code and fix what needs fixing
tasks.summary: A file-by-file review plus a second reviewer found six things worth fixing, all fixed with tests and shipped the same morning; the browser tests were run for the first time.

items.note: A nearly solved cube with one side copied turned around used to fail as ambiguous; the search now counts cubes, not turn combinations, and prefers the fewest turned sides.
The 3x3 solver can no longer be set up twice by two overlapping solving screens, and a reload on the bottom check lands on the bottom check.
A camera stream that arrives after its sheet was cancelled is stopped instead of leaking, and a busy camera no longer turns the live camera off for good.
Reads and writes the pieces as UTF-8 so the build gives the same page on any machine.
